motion.name: identity-variation-fade
motion.purpose: Three complete orange, blue and purple layers each hold for five seconds and fade for one second. Reduced motion disables animation and shows complete orange. Embedded SVG supplies no host callback for offscreen pausing.

components.name: Three-state identity banner
components.description: The exact shipped desktop SVG layers and glyph paths, with its internal animation CSS separated for the self-contained shadow-DOM preview. Blue mirrors the fields; reduced motion retains complete orange.
components.css: .ds-hero{width:100%;height:auto}.orange{animation:orange-fade 18s ease-in-out infinite}.blue{animation:blue-fade 18s ease-in-out infinite}.purple{animation:purple-fade 18s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes orange-fade{0%,27.778%,100%{opacity:1}33.333%,94.444%{opacity:0}}@keyframes blue-fade{0%,27.778%,66.667%,100%{opacity:0}33.333%,61.111%{opacity:1}}@keyframes purple-fade{0%,61.111%,100%{opacity:0}66.667%,94.444%{opacity:1}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.variation{animation:none}.orange{opacity:1}.blue,.purple{opacity:0}}

components.name: Technology module
components.description: Transparent fixed-size module with attributed brand geometry and a smooth Open Sans label. This preview inlines the shipped SVG; README.md embeds a local image.

components.name: Frontend logo group
components.description: Supported heading and paragraph structure lets fixed-size logo modules wrap independently. Inline copies of actual SVGs illustrate the content; GitHub supplies native paragraph and heading spacing.

components.name: Stacked qualification blocks
components.description: Smooth outlined title images precede selectable school/provider prose. This self-contained preview inlines shipped transparent SVGs; README.md uses native image and prose elements.

components.name: Linked segmented connection banner
components.description: Actual desktop header and four contact SVG slices inside the native two-column/two-row table structure with real HTML destinations. Preview-only CSS scales inline vectors like the shipped image elements; GitHub owns visible table seams and native focus.

narrative.overview:
White and saturated square fields introduce Habib's identity through three complete orange, blue and purple variations. Smooth sans-serif lettering gives the name and WEB / DEVELOPER hierarchy the character of the user's named reference. A deep navy and white modular connection banner closes the reading sequence with four contacts inside its common table boundary.

The full experience renders in README.md. The primary reference governs the three identity compositions; the second reference governs the modular connection geometry. Authored self-contained SVG paths reproduce their abstract material while GitHub supplies native headings, prose and link behavior. The exact reference typeface is unknown; Open Sans is a licensed visual match.
keyCharacteristics: Three saturated identity variations with full-banner fades.
Smooth outlined sans-serif lettering throughout active SVG assets.
Prominent phone identity above the decorative square field.
One native GitHub column with independently wrapping logo groups.
Stacked qualification titles followed by selectable institution prose.
Four independently linked contacts inside a segmented connection banner.
dos: Do retain the primary reference's orange, blue and purple compositions and mirrored blue fields.
Do use smooth Open Sans Bezier outlines throughout active SVG lettering.
Do preserve the complete orange reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep technology modules at their declared dimensions and let each group wrap independently.
Do keep school/provider and About facts as native selectable prose.
Do keep four actual HTML contact links inside the common connection table boundary.
Do retain attributed brand geometry, local font licenses and unchanged reference provenance.
donts: Don't assert the unknown screenshot typeface is exactly Open Sans.
Don't add pixel typography, emojis, generated scenes, a cat or Featured Work to the active profile.
Don't promise custom README CSS, seamless table slices, SVG image-map links, hover controls or host-driven offscreen pausing.
Don't introduce proficiency, dates or graduation claims.
